messages:
maria-finance: Heads up — Novus Retail had a huge one-off ingestion on Mar billing cycle, asking for a one-time overage credit. attaching details below.
aj-sales: ah, saw they pinged me. do we have invoice # and numbers?
maria-finance: Invoice INV-2026-0456. expected ~2m tokens, billed 12.4m. overage ~10.4m tokens. list price $0.0005/token -> overage $5,200.
oli-revops: @maria-finance can you paste the usage spike reason? need to capture precedent.
maria-finance: they ran a data-migration + reindex job accidentally across prod indexes. prod tag got applied to a bulk job. not an app-level surge. customer swears it was operator error.
aj-sales: customer requesting 80% credit on the overage. seems steep. they’re SMB, on Starter. asking to keep them from churning.
maria-finance: propose one-time concession: 20% credit of the overage ($1,040). offsets goodwill + still enforces usage economics.
devon-cs: they’re on a month-to-month plan, churn risk medium. 20% sounds reasonable to keep trust.
natalie-legal: legal OK with a one-off credit if it’s documented as a service goodwill credit and we don’t change terms. we need an internal memo and a note on the invoice.
oli-revops: need a quick precedent check — any recent similar one-offs? @pricebot search-dealdesk "one-time credit" last 6 months
pricebot: Found 3 matches. Typical credit range 10-30% for operator-error spikes < $10k. Ref DD-421, DD-512, DD-633.
aj-sales: thanks. @maria-finance can we do 20% and add a clause: one-time only, customer to enable cost guard rails?
maria-finance: yes. I’ll draft a credit memo and update invoice with line: "Service goodwill credit — operator error". credit = $1,040.
natalie-legal: add: "No change to subscription or pricing. This credit does not establish a pricing precedent"
oli-revops: +1 on wording. record in Deal Desk tracker and tag customer record.
aj-sales: customer also asked for a temporary bump to Starter caps for 30 days to avoid repeat. can we grant a temporary soft limit increase w/ monitoring?
maria-finance: we can do a 30-day temporary cap increase but it must be manually reviewed after and we’ll require cost alerts enabled.
devon-cs: I’ll notify the CS contact and confirm they enable alerts.
pricebot: Created deal desk request DD-789 for Novus Retail. Status: pending-approvals.
maria-finance: Approvals needed: finance sign-off (this thread), revops ack, legal note. If no objections in 24h I’ll apply credit and update invoice.
natalie-legal: Approved (legal). :white_check_mark:
oli-revops: Approved (revops) — log in tracker and note the monitoring requirement. :thumbsup:
aj-sales: Approved on behalf of sales. will follow up w/ customer comms. :pray:
maria-finance: Approved (finance) — applying $1,040 credit and issuing updated invoice. logging memo to Deal Desk DD-789.
pricebot: Invoice INV-2026-0456 updated: credit applied. New total = original - $1,040.
aj-sales: thanks team. Devon can you post the customer note draft here when ready?
devon-cs: will do.
pricebot: Thread closed by pricebot after action: credit_applied."
